derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.72 showed all five optimized heads met their absolute source gates but optimization reduced median source AUROC from bootstrap-prototype 0.908333 to 0.848889. This candidate therefore discards optimization and uses only the five bootstrap prototypes. Bangkok is post-hoc because it influenced earlier marker-conditioned hypotheses and receives no prospective credit.

prototype_ensemble.model: unit mean of source-bootstrap same-source positive-minus-nearest-negative deltas
prototype_ensemble.aggregation: median of five event-relative prototype projections

causal_profile.prerequisite: frozen r7.25 radial candidate already exists
causal_profile.baseline: per prototype median of the first three accepted event samples only
causal_profile.risk_profile: median across prototypes of current projection minus that prototype baseline
causal_profile.clear: reuse frozen event-local r7.30 nine consecutive absent samples
